subject: Architecture
title: Digital Twins for Buildings
description: A quick win: understand Digital Twins for Buildings.

hook.text: Every major new building will soon have a digital twin — a virtual copy updated in real time by sensors.

buildup.text: Sensors feed temperature, strain, vibration, and occupancy data into a 3D model that mirrors the real structure.

discovery.text: Engineers can test changes on the digital twin first — simulating renovations without touching the real building.

twist.text: The twin can predict failures before they happen — a pipe about to burst shows stress patterns days early.

climax.text: Singapore's government created a digital twin of the entire city — every building, road, and pipe simulated.

punchline.text: Two buildings for the price of one. The virtual one might matter more.

quiz.question: What can a digital twin predict?
options: Future market value of the property
How many tenants will occupy the building
